note: the queries file names a different module than the manifest that points at it

queries.name: curve
queries.summary: Boost against RPM for one car, excluding stale readings
queries.sql:
SELECT o.rpm, b.boost_psi, b.map_kpa, b.baro_kpa
FROM obd o
ASOF JOIN boost b ON o.vehicle_id = b.vehicle_id AND o.boot_id = b.boot_id AND o.mono_ms >= b.mono_ms
WHERE o.vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND b.boost_psi IS NOT NULL AND o.mono_ms - b.mono_ms < 2000
ORDER BY o.rpm

queries.name: peak-for-trip
queries.sql:
SELECT max(boost_psi) AS peak_boost_psi
FROM boost
WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND boot_id = $boot_id AND boost_psi IS NOT NULL

queries.name: pulls

params.name: limit
params.summary: how many, default is the server's

queries.sql: SELECT * FROM v_pulls WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT $limit
